gloss_en: Propose adding a stair width property to IfcStair/IfcStairFlight so accessibility and fire code checks can be automated.
title_original: IFC Schema Recommendation: Inclusion of Stair Width Property in IfcStair and IfcStairFlight entities
question_paraphrase: While working through accessibility code I see IfcStair has no direct width property; suggest Width/StairWidth in Pset_StairCommon to support rule-based compliance checks.
phrasing_notes: formal proposal register, bulleted benefits, polite closing
answer_summary: Maintainer agrees only a length quantity exists, prefers geometric rule checking; submitter (referencing CORENET X) argues for a hybrid of quantitative properties plus geometry.

gloss_en: Official Singapore CORENET X portal: IFC+SG start guide, data structure and Excel mapping file, model checker, readiness self-check, seven regulatory agencies.
question_paraphrase: Portal describing IFC+SG onboarding checklist, data structure and mapping requirements, authoring guidance, glossary of identified components, readiness self-check and Model Checker; agencies BCA, LTA, NEA, NParks, PUB, SCDF, URA.
phrasing_notes: official bureaucratic wording; users will ask in terms of IFC+SG, mapping file, identified components
answer_summary: Submission to seven agencies is organised around IFC+SG data requirements validated by a model checker.

gloss_en: Author asks testers to try browser tools that check an IFC delivery against IDS, compare two deliveries and explore clashes, and judge if reports are usable in coordination meetings.
title_original: Syntopy IFC apps powered by TopologicPy
question_paraphrase: Three apps framed as: where do elements clash, does the model contain required information, what changed since last delivery; asks which model conditions break them.
phrasing_notes: practitioner framing as three plain questions
answer_summary: TopologicCheck validates against IDS; TopologicCompare diffs deliveries; processing is local via WebAssembly.

gloss_en: GitHub issue listing organizations and initiatives working on permitting automation.
question_paraphrase: Issue titled as a list of organizations and initiatives in permitting automation in the OpenPermit project.

gloss_en: Check whether the model has the data required for a Singapore CORENET X submission
prompt: need to submit to corenet x tomorrow, can u check if my ifc has all the IFC-SG required classes and psets? list what's missing
expected_behavior: Inspect IFC classes and property sets against the IFC+SG requirements the user supplies or the tool knows; report missing items per class; do not claim agency approval.

gloss_en: Find stairs lacking width data
prompt: which IfcStair / IfcStairFlight have no width anywhere? psets, quantities, doesnt matter. i need to check min stair width for egress
expected_behavior: List stairs, search Pset/Qto/attributes for width, fall back to geometry-derived width, report stairs with no data.

gloss_en: Validate against an IDS
prompt: run this IDS against the model and give me failures grouped by requirement, not one huge list
expected_behavior: Run IDS validation, group failures by requirement and entity type, summarize counts.

gloss_en: Check room areas and fire-compartment area against a limit
prompt: all IfcSpace on level 2 with area, and is any fire compartment over 1000 m2? name the spaces
expected_behavior: Read IfcSpace areas from Qto or geometry, group by zone/compartment, compare to threshold, list offenders.

gloss_en: Explain how to represent fire rating
prompt: where should fire rating live in IFC for permit checking, FireRating in Pset_WallCommon or custom?
expected_behavior: Explain Pset_*Common FireRating, note regional requirements may differ; offer to check which walls have it.

gloss_en: Check the model against expertise requirements for IFC submission
prompt: проверь ifc на соответствие требованиям к ТИМ для госэкспертизы: есть ли классы, уровни, обязательные свойства, что не заполнено
expected_behavior: Check classes, storeys and required properties; report gaps; state that the exact national requirement list must be supplied.

gloss_en: List rooms with area and purpose for explanatory note
prompt: выведи таблицей все помещения: номер, назначение, площадь, этаж. для экспликации
expected_behavior: Extract IfcSpace data into a table, flag missing fields.

gloss_en: Check evacuation door widths
prompt: 帮我审一下这个ifc模型，疏散门宽度有没有小于0.9米的，列出楼层和编号
expected_behavior: Find IfcDoor on evacuation routes, read width, list those below 0.9 m with storey and tag.

gloss_en: How to prepare a model for automated review
prompt: 报建用的模型导出IFC要注意什么？构件编码和属性怎么挂才能被智能审查识别
expected_behavior: Explain classification codes, property mapping, export settings; say specifics depend on local review platform.

gloss_en: Check ceiling height for building confirmation
prompt: 確認申請用のIFCです。居室の天井高が2.1m未満の部屋と面積を一覧にしてください
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with height and area, filter by 2.1 m, tabulate.

gloss_en: Check stair tread and riser dimensions
prompt: 건축허가용 IFC인데 계단 챌판 높이랑 디딤판 폭 기준 안 맞는 계단 찾아줘
expected_behavior: Read stair geometry or properties, compare riser and tread against supplied limits, list failures.

gloss_en: Check permit data on rooms
prompt: Bauantrag IFC: haben alle Räume NetFloorArea und Nutzungsart? Liste die ohne bitte
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace missing area or usage and report.

gloss_en: Ask whether IFC can be filed for licence
prompt: se puede presentar el IFC directamente para la licencia de obras o solo pdf? que tendria que revisar antes
expected_behavior: Explain it depends on the municipality and that IFC permit submission is rare; list model checks to run.

gloss_en: Check accessibility of doors and corridors
prompt: vérifie l'accessibilité PMR : portes < 90 cm et couloirs < 1,40 m dans la maquette, liste avec niveau
expected_behavior: Measure doors and corridor spaces, list those under thresholds with storey.

gloss_en: Check building height and setback
prompt: confere a altura total do edificio e o recuo do lote no ifc, preciso pro alvará
expected_behavior: Compute building height from storeys/bounding box, state site boundary needed for setback.

gloss_en: Check mandatory properties by class
prompt: controlla che muri e solai abbiano Pset_Common con IsExternal e LoadBearing, elenca quelli senza
expected_behavior: Check psets on IfcWall and IfcSlab, list missing.
